summary: uiopt is a DSH WebUI enhancement plugin that adds in-chat balance and per-message usage display, provider icons, and an extra-plugins import and mount management entry in settings.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is a DSH WebUI bundle that primarily enhances the chat interface by showing account-related display elements (real-time balance, session usage, per-message cost/cache rate) and provider branding, with an added settings tab for managing extra plugins. The host/client split and declared bundle in package.json plus documented host endpoints and imports in the README indicate a UI-facing enhancement and local plugin-management function, while also touching profile-level file mounts during plugin import/uninstall operations.
